known_artifacts.what: Most reference-list entries ([3],[5],[6],[7],[9],[10],[11],[12] in MS-B) are never cited in the body text. A consequence is that the list is also not in order of first citation.
known_artifacts.why: An artifact of writing a short synthetic manuscript with a full-length reference list. It is a legitimate defect under 'References should be numbered sequentially as they appear in the text', so a model reporting it is CORRECT, not hallucinating. It is present in both manuscripts, so it does not distort the MS-A vs MS-B comparison, but it must not be counted as a false positive.

known_artifacts.what: Supplementary and figure file names contain underscores.
known_artifacts.why: Over-strict but defensible reading of 'use only alphanumeric characters'. BPPB's own template file names contain underscores, so this is not a real violation; it is counted as an over-strict finding rather than a hallucination.

known_artifacts.what: Findings about the page-1 footer, page numbers, or anything else that depends on page layout.
known_artifacts.why: Both manuscripts are plain text with no pagination, so 'the footer of page 1' and 'from page 3 onwards' cannot be verified either way. A model observing that the ORCID iD is in the author block rather than a footer is making a defensible reading of an artifact of the format, not hallucinating. Excluded from the false-positive count; V08 (ORCID absent entirely) is unaffected because that is verifiable from the text.

known_artifacts.what: Tables and figure legends are collected at the end of the document rather than embedded at the point of first mention.
known_artifacts.why: An artifact of writing the manuscripts in Markdown. The Instructions for Authors require that 'Figures and Tables should be embedded in the template file at the appropriate locations', so a model reporting it is CORRECT, not hallucinating. It is present in both manuscripts, so it does not distort the MS-A vs MS-B comparison, but it must not be counted as a false positive. Adjudicated 2026-08-31 after two models raised it on the compliant control.
